labeller: claude-opus-5-5, 2026-10-31, prompt figure-labels/4; Claude Code subagent by hand: every crop viewed with the Read tool plus 110 dpi page overviews (pymupdf); no API call

kinds.photo_illustration: photo or photorealistic rendering of the product, no data
kinds.dimension_drawing: technical drawing carrying dimension letters or values
kinds.sectional_exploded: sectional, cutaway or exploded view with position callouts, no dimensions
kinds.table_icon: small product image placed beside or inside a table
kinds.annotated_ui_illustration: screenshot or UI illustration with annotations
kinds.logo: logo, badge or icon carrying no data

flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/fig-1.1.description: Flowserve logo (red wordmark with swoosh) at the top of the cover page.
flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/fig-1.1.notes: Azure read the registered mark as '@'.

flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/fig-1.2.description: Product rendering of the Worcester F51/F52 reduced port flanged ball valve with red-sleeved locking lever wrench.
flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/fig-1.2.notes: 'FLOWSERVE' is printed on the wrench sleeve, 'CL150' is cast on the body (small, read from the crop). Neither points to a table.

flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/fig-2.1.description: Rendering of the flanged ball valve fitted with a yellow pneumatic actuator with a red/white position indicator on top.
flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/fig-2.1.notes: The body marking reads 'DN50/40' (reduced port); Azure read it as 'PAN.50/40'. No caption.

flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/fig-3.1.description: Cutaway rendering of the F51/F52 ball valve (body section in red) with feature callouts 1, 2, 5, 6, 8 and 9.

legend.2: Standard anti-blowout, duplex stainless steel stem

flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/fig-3.1.notes: The crop also cuts through the page heading 'Features and benefits' (shown as 'tures and benefits'). The numbered feature list 1-9 is printed below the figure on page 3; callouts 3, 4 and 7 are on the inset (fig-3.2), so they are mapped there. 'FLOWSERVE' printed on the wrench sleeve is not a callout.

flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/fig-3.2.description: Circular inset: cutaway of the stem and gland area showing the locking clip, live-loaded packing and anti-static device, callouts 3, 4 and 7.
flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/fig-3.2.notes: Callout 3 is cut at the top edge of the crop (visible on the page overview); Azure listed only '4' and '7'. Names from the feature list on page 3 ('see inset' for 3 and 4).

flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/fig-4.1.description: Exploded view of the DN15 to DN50 (NPS 1/2 to 2) valve with item callouts 1-23 matching the parts and materials list beside it.
flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/fig-4.1.notes: Caption 'Sizes DN15 to DN50 (NPS 1/2 to 2)' is the blue subheading above the figure (Azure took it as caption; correct). Callouts 5, 11, 19 and 20 point to two parts each. Legend names from the Item/Description columns of the table on page 4; 'Body' and 'Insert' carry a superscript footnote mark in the table.

flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/fig-5.1.description: Exploded view of the DN80 to DN200 (NPS 3 to 8) valve with item callouts 1-25 matching the parts and materials list beside it.
flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/fig-5.1.notes: Caption 'Sizes DN80 to DN200 (NPS 3 to 8)' is the subheading above the figure. Callouts 5, 10, 13, 20, 23 and 24 point to two parts each. Legend names from the table on page 5.

flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/fig-6.1.description: Pressure/temperature rating chart: pressure bar (psi) versus temperature °C (°F) with body rating curves for Group 1.2/2.2 Class 150/300 and seat-material limit lines (Delrin, UHMWPE, Virgin PTFE, Reinforced PTFE, Fluorofill, PEEK, Metals A and G).
flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/fig-6.1.notes: Title is the page heading 'Pressure/temperature ratings' above the crop; no caption. Seat curves are identified by colour swatches below the plot (Delrin red, UHMWPE orange, Virgin PTFE light green, Reinforced PTFE dark green, Fluorofill dark blue, PEEK light blue, Metals A and G maroon). Azure read the degree sign as '℃ (ºF)'.

flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/fig-8.1.description: Dimension drawings of the DN15 to DN50 valve: top view with mounting platform, sectional side view and end view of the stem, with dimension letters A-T2 that point to the dimension table.
labels: Sizes DN15 to DN50 (NPS ½ to 2)
Mounting platform drilling/location to BS EN ISO 5211
sub_captions: Sizes DN15 to DN50 (NPS ½ to 2)
flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/fig-8.1.notes: No printed numeric dimensions; all are letters resolved by the table 'Dimensions indicated in mm (in.)' below. The port symbol is printed rotated as 'ØS' (Azure: '0S'); it corresponds to the 'S Ø' column (interpretation). 'L' is the mounting hole thread and depth and 'F'/'G' the stem across-flats and thread, named in the callouts.

flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/fig-9.1.description: Dimension drawings of the DN80 to DN200 valve: top view with mounting platform, sectional side view and stem section, with dimension letters A-K that point to the dimension table.
labels: Mounting platform drilling/location to BS EN ISO 5211
flowserve-worcester-f51-f52/fig-9.1.notes: No printed numeric dimensions. Azure's text for this figure contains many stray letters/digits (A, B, C, D, E, F, G, 1-7) that are not visible as labels in the crop; several of them leaked into the page-9 table cells (e.g. 'F52 5', 'F07 B B', 'H 16.8'). The K dimension line has a break symbol (handle shortened).
